expected_subject: audit(phase063): attest v1022 code runtime delta

findings.summary: C-rate h^-1 is passed to the SI kinetic prefactor without division by 3600; lag is overstated by 3600 and the equivalent barrier shift is RT ln 3600.
The finite-rate blend path sends the same full cell current and capacity to both hosts and does not solve host current partition.
from_wt implements the algebra, but default q_Si values mix theoretical, first-charge and reversible bases without utilization/ICE/active-mass closure.
Missing dH_a or dVdq_qa silently collapses finite-current lag to zero/equilibrium rather than failing closed.
The v1.0.23 curve QA script hard-codes /home/user/Project_Anode_Fit and is not portable to the frozen Windows execution environment; Python 3.14 additionally lacks its optional matplotlib dependency.
solve_U_oc does not validate tol or max_iter, so zero/negative iterations or infinite tolerance can silently return an unconverged initial-bracket midpoint.
The v1.0.22 production header still declares release version 1.0.21 even though the module contains the v1.0.22 blend extension.
The shared v1.0.22/v1.0.23 legacy gate reports the 30 wt% Si-C endpoint as approximately 0.7 capacity fraction although the implemented constants give about 0.782.
CODE_GUIDE_v23 labels plastic_hysteresis_loop and nonadditive_correction together as GS-1 even though the latter is the GS-2 boundary.
All three FITTING_GUIDE occurrences share a v1.0.20/v1.0.19-oriented blob and do not route the v1.0.22 blend or v1.0.23 self-consistent endpoints.
p1_ratio_check.py is observation-only: it prints convergence ratios but has no assertions or nonzero failure exit.
The v1.0.21/v1.0.22/v1.0.23 primary gate docstrings all advertise the stale test_gates_v1020.py reproduction command rather than their actual versioned entry points.

solve_U_oc does not enforce per-transition Q_j>0 or n_j(T)>0 before using the monotone-bisection premise; admissible-looking inputs can therefore create multiple charge-balance roots and the solver silently selects one.

static_contracts.basis: Exact U/w/Q demo literals and selector-to-constant mapping; these remain labelled placeholders, not material truth.
Exact case-specific q_Si and graphite q_gr defaults used by from_wt; mixed basis remains an open finding.
Constructor scaling path that removes all positive-Q silicon transitions when f_Si=0.
Constructor assigns Cbg to graphite and zero to the silicon host.
GS-1 plastic closure is an explicit NotImplementedError boundary.
GS-2 nonadditive finite-rate closure is an explicit NotImplementedError boundary.
Mass-fraction guard and mass-to-capacity mapping path.

theory_code_concordance.basis: causal memory is implemented; local state-dependent kinetics is frozen
pooled common-potential charge balance has a unique monotone root only under the unguarded per-transition domain Q_j>0 and n_j(T)>0
mass-to-capacity algebra matches; capacity/utilization/ICE basis is not closed
static stress offset exists; plastic history closure raises NotImplementedError
both hosts receive the same full current; nonadditive correction raises NotImplementedError
curve maps c_rate*Q_cell directly into an SI kinetic prefactor without division by 3600
cut/cap and frozen-local lag resolver are explicit approximation operators
separate reversible and lumped irreversible exits exist; branch dissipation closure remains outside this row
electronic entropy is evaluated at fixed T_ref and x_center, not local composition-temperature closure
